profile.summary: Planting Justice is an Oakland nonprofit and social enterprise focused on food justice and economic opportunity. It runs nurseries and urban farms, provides living-wage jobs for people affected by mass incarceration, and offers food distribution, youth internships and school programs about urban agriculture.

review.notes: ProPublica and the organization's own pages agree on an Oakland 501(c)(3) named Planting Justice (EIN 27-0334905, 319 105th Ave., (510) 756-6965) that runs school-based agriculture programs and youth internships, which fits OUSD's Classroom & academic programs contracts at Dewey Academy. The summary is neutral and supported by the About and What We Do pages; no source names OUSD directly, but the name, city, and services match closely.
